name: Irvine Police Department Explorer Program
what_you_do: Train with Irvine police. Help with traffic control, community events and DUI checkpoints. After a 5-day academy, you can ride along on patrol.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18, or finished 8th grade and going into 9th. You must live in Irvine or go to school there. Keep a C or better in every class. You cannot have criminal convictions or serious traffic offenses.
pay_detail: Unpaid. The page calls it a volunteer program.
duration: Most Explorers stay until high school graduation
deadline_text: Send in the interest card by January 1 for the winter session or by June 1 for the summer session. The page does not state the year.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Interest Form on the program page. Interest cards are due January 1 for winter or June 1 for summer. Email ipdexplorers@cityofirvine.org with questions.
notes: The Orange County Explorer Academy is held twice a year. It is a hard 5-day program. You must finish it within a year of joining. The group also takes trips, such as a weekend in Sacramento for the Peace Officers' Memorial.
